supplements.title: Effect of stereochemistry at position C14 on the antiproliferative activity and selectivity of simplified oridonin O-acylated derivatives.
supplements.summary: C14α-configured oridonin derivatives showed enhanced antiproliferative activity against SU-DHL-6 lymphoma cells, with compound 6k demonstrating the most potent effect.

supplements.title: Digitally Delivered Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Inflammation-Guided Nutrition to Enhance Recovery and Survival After Abdominoperineal Resection (APR): A Prospective Non-Randomized Controlled Cohort Study.
supplements.summary: For low rectal cancer patients after surgery, a digital therapy app and personalized nutrition plan reduced inflammation and improved recovery and potential survival outcomes.

supplements.title: Impact of Perioperative Nutrition Intervention on Bioimpedance Phase Angle in Patients With Breast Cancer: A Systematic Review.
supplements.summary: Targeted nutrition support during breast cancer treatment may improve patient health by preserving cellular integrity, as measured by bioimpedance phase angle.

supplements.title: Recommendations from the European interdisciplinary council on ageing on physical activity and diet for mental health conditions in older adults.
supplements.summary: Regular physical activity and Mediterranean diet interventions can help prevent and manage mental health conditions and cognitive decline in older adults.

supplements.title: Exercise training decreases Neuregulin-1 concentrations in HER2-positive breast cancer patients undergoing adjuvant trastuzumab: the CARDAPAC study.
supplements.summary: Exercise training reduced Neuregulin-1 levels in HER2-positive breast cancer patients receiving trastuzumab, potentially mitigating treatment-related heart damage.

supplements.title: Morin induces ferroptosis in endometrial cancer cells by down-regulating FTH1.
supplements.summary: Morin triggers cell death in endometrial cancer by reducing FTH1 protein levels, potentially offering a new targeted treatment approach.

supplements.title: Untargeted mass spectrometry to investigate ocean acidification in Cancer borealis using optimized metabolite extraction methods.
supplements.summary: In Cancer borealis, ocean acidification triggered metabolic changes in 15 metabolites, with isopropanol extraction revealing potential stress response pathways.

supplements.title: Ultra-processed food and mortality among long-term cancer survivors from the Moli-sani Study: prospective findings and analysis of biological pathways.
supplements.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence for this research:

Higher consumption of ultra-processed foods was linked to increased mortality risk among cancer survivors.

supplements.title: Celastrol exerts a neuroprotective effect by inhibiting necroptosis and inflammation in intracerebral hemorrhage-induced brain injury.
supplements.summary: Celastrol protects brain cells by reducing inflammation and cell death after intracerebral hemorrhage, potentially offering a new treatment approach.

supplements.title: Chemical composition and cytotoxicity of the essential oil of Calophyllum fraseri M.R.Hend. & Wyatt-Sm.
supplements.summary: Calophyllum fraseri essential oil showed weak cytotoxic potential against liver, breast, and lung cancer cell lines, with promising molecular interactions for potential future research.

supplements.title: Effects of Acute Exercise and 12-Week High-Intensity Interval Training on Inflammatory Biomarkers in Stable Coronary Artery Disease: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
supplements.summary: In stable coronary artery disease patients, high-intensity interval training significantly reduced inflammatory markers, suggesting exercise may help manage cardiovascular disease progression.

supplements.title: Dietary Patterns and Prostate Cancer Risk in the Multiethnic Cohort Study.
supplements.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

A diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains may lower prostate cancer risk across different ethnic populations.

supplements.title: Exploring the Mechanism of Oral Cancer With Shikonin Based on the Network Pharmacology and Molecular Docking Technology.
supplements.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

Shikonin shows potential as a promising natural compound for treating oral cancer by targeting multiple molecular pathways.

supplements.title: 20(R)-Ginsenoside Rg3 Suppresses P-Glycoprotein-Mediated Multidrug Resistance in A549/Taxol Cells by Targeting MDM2-IκB-α Signaling Axis.
supplements.summary: 20(R)-Ginsenoside Rg3 disrupts a key molecular pathway in drug-resistant lung cancer cells, potentially increasing their sensitivity to chemotherapy.

supplements.title: MoS2-Doped Iron Oxide Nanozyme with Co-Catalytic Enhancement for Tumor Ferroptosis Guided by Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
supplements.summary: MoS2-doped iron oxide nanoparticles enhanced with tamoxifen and albumin significantly improve cancer cell death by boosting reactive oxygen species generation.

off_label.title: New mechanistic insights into targeted protein degradation using Raman-active theranostic hydrophobic tags.
off_label.summary: A new hydrophobic tag coupled with olaparib more effectively degrades PARP-1 in ovarian cancer cells, enhancing anti-cancer activity through targeted protein removal.

off_label.title: Exploring dual inhibitors Carbonic Anhydrases and Phosphodiesterase 5 as potential agents for treatment Alzheimer's disease.
off_label.summary: A novel dual-targeting drug compound 8a shows promise in reducing memory loss and brain cell damage in Alzheimer's disease by inhibiting two key enzymes.

off_label.title: Evaluation of metformin's effect on 5-fluorouracil-induced cardiotoxicity through cellular protection.
off_label.summary: Metformin may protect heart cells from damage caused by 5-fluorouracil chemotherapy, potentially reducing toxic side effects during cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Age-stratified clinical outcomes and adverse events in patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer receiving triplet therapy with darolutamide, androgen deprivation therapy, and docetaxel.
off_label.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

In metastatic prostate cancer, older and younger patients receiving a triple drug combination showed similar treatment responses and manageable side effects.

off_label.title: PI3K inhibition in combination with tamoxifen in patients with metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer: clinical and circulating tumor DNA results.
off_label.summary: Combining taselisib (a targeted therapy) with tamoxifen showed promising results in treating hormone-sensitive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer patients by potentially improving treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: Modulation of AMPK/SIRT1 signaling by piribedil attenuates cyclophosphamide-induced nephrotoxicity via PI3K/Akt, MAPKs, and TLR4/NLRP3 pathways with regulation of KIM-1/NGAL.
off_label.summary: Piribedil protects kidney cells from chemotherapy-induced damage by reducing inflammation and cellular stress through multiple molecular signaling pathways.

off_label.title: Epigenetic Metal-Organic Framework Nanoagonist Overcomes Triple Defenses to Enable Effective Chemo-Metalloimmunotherapy in Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer.
off_label.summary: A novel nanoparticle targeting ovarian cancer overcomes drug resistance by simultaneously damaging cancer cells and boosting immune response.

off_label.title: Engineering Tick Evasins as Multitarget Chemokine Inhibitors─A Biomimetic Approach To Tackling the Complexity of the Immune System.
off_label.summary: Researchers engineered tick proteins called evasins to simultaneously block multiple inflammatory chemokines, offering a potential new approach to treating complex inflammatory diseases like cancer.

off_label.title: Impact of proton pump inhibitor use on immune-related adverse events in patients with non-small cell lung cancer: a retrospective study.
off_label.summary: Proton pump inhibitors may negatively impact immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment effectiveness in non-small cell lung cancer patients by altering gut microbiota.

off_label.title: Niacin Modulates Immune Responses in a Phase I Dose-Escalation Clinical Trial of Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma.
off_label.summary: Niacin supplementation shows promise in enhancing immune responses for patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma, potentially improving treatment outcomes for this aggressive brain cancer.

off_label.title: Artemether as a modulator of EMT in colorectal cancer: enhancing radiosensitivity and reversing chemo-radiation resistance.
off_label.summary: Artemether treatment enhanced radiation sensitivity and reduced resistance in colorectal cancer by disrupting cancer cell transformation mechanisms.

off_label.title: Gastroprotective effect of Kahweol against ethanol-induced gastric ulcer by employing in silico, in vitro and in vivo approaches.
off_label.summary: Kahweol, a coffee-derived compound, significantly protects against ethanol-induced gastric ulcers by reducing inflammation, acid secretion, and bacterial growth.

off_label.title: A comparative study of some NSAIDs with natural products: integrating in vitro anticancer efficacy, in vivo antiulcerative effect, histochemistry, and in silico analysis.
off_label.summary: Celecoxib combined with taxifolin showed promising anticancer effects against breast and colon cancer cells and reduced gastric mucosal injury in rats.

off_label.title: Treatment resistance to platinum-based chemotherapy in lung and ovarian cancer is driven by a targetable TGFβ senescent secretome.
off_label.summary: In lung and ovarian cancer, chemotherapy-induced senescent cells secrete TGFβ, promoting tumor growth, which can be reduced by targeted inhibitors.

off_label.title: Cannabinoids and drug-drug pharmacokinetic interactions: Deciphering the risks.
off_label.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

This review explores potential drug interactions between cannabinoids and medications used to treat mental health disorders, cancer, and cardiometabolic diseases.

biomarkers.title: EPB41L family serves as a prognostic biomarker for kidney renal clear cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: EPB41L family proteins are potential prognostic biomarkers for kidney cancer, with low expression linked to reduced survival and poor patient outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Acceptance and the willingness to pay for human papilloma virus (HPV) vaccine: A systematic review.
biomarkers.summary: A systematic review reveals HPV vaccine acceptance and willingness to pay vary globally, with knowledge, attitude, and socioeconomic factors influencing uptake across different income levels.

biomarkers.title: Apoptosis-related genes influence prognosis and immune characteristics of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Certain cell death-related genes significantly affect survival and immune response in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma patients.

biomarkers.title: Cost of managing brain metastases in ALK-positive advanced NSCLC patients receiving first-line ALK TKIs in China.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers analyzed the healthcare expenses associated with brain metastases in Chinese lung cancer patients treated with targeted ALK inhibitor drugs.

biomarkers.title: Immunogenicity and efficacy of a rabies-based vaccine against highly pathogenic influenza H5N1 virus.
biomarkers.summary: A rabies-based vaccine successfully produced neutralizing antibodies and protected mice against highly pathogenic H5N1 influenza virus in both live and inactivated forms.

biomarkers.title: [68Ga]Ga-FAPI Surpasses [18F]FDG in Pancreatic Adenosquamous Carcinoma Restaging.
biomarkers.summary: In pancreatic adenosquamous carcinoma, [68Ga]Ga-FAPI PET/CT outperformed [18F]FDG PET/CT by detecting cancer recurrence more accurately.

biomarkers.title: 18F-FDG PET/CT Findings in a Case of Primary Leptomeningeal Melanomatosis With Diastematomyelia.
biomarkers.summary: An advanced imaging technique (18F-FDG PET/CT) helped identify and locate a rare, aggressive form of spinal cord melanoma for potential biopsy.

biomarkers.title: A Rare Linitis Plastica Manifestation of Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma With Diffuse Gastric Metastasis Revealed by 18F-FDG PET/CT.
biomarkers.summary: 18F-FDG PET/CT helped diagnose a rare case of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma with extensive diffuse gastric metastasis.

biomarkers.title: Refining M1-Stage Stratification in De Novo Metastatic Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Using 18F-FDG PET/CT: Preliminary Evidence.
biomarkers.summary: PET/CT imaging suggests a potential new way to more precisely categorize metastatic stages in nasopharyngeal cancer patients beyond current staging systems.

biomarkers.title: Mutations and structural variants arising during double-strand break repair.
biomarkers.summary: During double-strand break repair in yeast, mutations frequently occur, including base substitutions, small deletions, and rare chromosomal template switches, revealing complex DNA repair mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals tumor microenvironment-driven subtypes of invasive lobular carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: By analyzing tumor microenvironment interactions, researchers identified four distinct subtypes of invasive lobular breast cancer with different clinical outcomes and prognostic potential.

biomarkers.title: Discovery and preclinical evaluation of monoclonal antibodies and bispecific engagers targeting the NKG2A inhibitory receptor.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed antibodies that block NKG2A, enabling immune cells to more effectively attack lung cancer cells in preclinical studies.

biomarkers.title: Injury-induced electrochemical coupling triggers organ growth.
biomarkers.summary: Electric signals generated by fin injury trigger cell proliferation in zebrafish, enabling rapid tissue regeneration through membrane potential changes and calcium responses.

biomarkers.title: Single-molecule localization microscopy reveals the molecular organization of endogenous membrane receptors.
biomarkers.summary: Single-molecule microscopy reveals detailed molecular organization of immune cell receptors, potentially improving cancer antibody therapy for multiple myeloma.

biomarkers.title: Unveiling the landscape of m5C RNA methylation in lung cancer: From molecular mechanisms to therapeutic opportunities.
biomarkers.summary: In lung cancer, RNA methylation by m5C writers and readers promotes tumor progression by stabilizing oncogenic transcripts and modulating cellular processes.

trials.summary: A deep learning AI model accurately predicts breast cancer patients' likelihood of complete treatment response using pre-treatment biopsy images.
